describes: A Vercel preview deployment of HEAD, found with the Vercel CLI. A person pushes the branch (Vercel's Git integration builds the preview); the engine waits for a READY deployment of this commit and runs the e2e suite against it. If the project's previews post to GitHub Deployments, github-deployment needs no Vercel CLI.
verify: With a preview of HEAD ready, run the wait command once by hand from the repo root: it must print the preview's https URL and exit 0, and print nothing while the build is running. The --meta and --status filters are written from memory of the Vercel CLI; check them against `vercel ls --help` first. Then set "verified": true here, with the date and CLI version in "verifiedAgainst".
needs: the vercel CLI, logged in (or VERCEL_TOKEN in the environment) and the project linked (vercel link)
previews behind Deployment Protection: VERCEL_AUTOMATION_BYPASS_SECRET in the environment, sent by the e2e suite as the x-vercel-protection-bypass header
the e2e suite reading its base URL from $BASE_URL

recipe.name: e2e against the Vercel preview of HEAD

steps.note: Vercel's Git integration builds a preview of the pushed branch

steps.wait: vercel ls --meta githubCommitSha=$(git rev-parse HEAD) --status READY 2>/dev/null | grep -Eo 'https://[^ ]+' | head -1
steps.note: prints the URL of a READY deployment of this commit, nothing before
